analysis.evidence: וּבְנֵי יָוָן means “and the sons of Javan.” The names that follow identify his descendants and establish יָוָן as the name of their ancestor.
analysis.morphology: Unprefixed and unsuffixed proper noun in a genitive relationship with the preceding construct noun וּבְנֵי.

evidence.note: אֱלִישָׁה opens the list introduced by וּבְנֵי יָוָן, “and the sons of Javan.”

article.name: אֱלִישָׁה
article.summary: Genesis names Elishah among the sons of Javan. The meaning of his name is uncertain.

draft.change: Add a personal-name article for אֱלִישָׁה. The verse supports neither the proposed root אלח nor the gloss “night-mist; dew.”
draft.evidence: Genesis 10:4 lists Elishah first among the sons of Javan.

analysis.evidence: אֱלִישָׁה is the first name after וּבְנֵי יָוָן, “and the sons of Javan.” The heading identifies Elishah as a son of Javan. The verse gives no etymology for his name.
analysis.morphology: Hebrew proper noun. The final ה belongs to the name. There is no prefix or suffix.
